svg.title: EvidenceGraph — High-Level System Architecture
svg.desc: Overview of the EvidenceGraph infrastructure: Next.js user experience, Bun.js Hono API with SSE, Valkey/BullMQ queues, independent research and ingestion workers, LangGraph orchestration and RAG, PostgreSQL, Qdrant, Neo4j, S3/MinIO, external LLM and web integrations, and LangSmith observability.
